figures.name: Jayavarman VII

ability.name: Bodhisattva King
ability.description: Heal all allied cards for 5 HP and grant them +2 wisdom for 2 turns.

figures.description: The greatest Khmer king, builder of Angkor Thom and the Bayon, who embraced Buddhism and devoted his reign to healing his people.

figures.name: Preah Vishnu (Khmer)

ability.name: Cosmic Ocean
ability.description: Create a vast ocean field; all earth-domain enemies lose 3 power while aquatic allies gain 3.

figures.description: Vishnu as worshipped at Angkor Wat, the supreme preserver deity of the Khmer empire whose image graced the grandest temple.

figures.name: Shiva (Khmer)

ability.name: Devaraja Power
ability.description: Declare yourself the god-king; all allied cards gain +3 to all stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: Shiva worshipped as the supreme deity by many Khmer kings, whose lingam at the summit of the temple mountain symbolized divine kingship.

figures.name: Neak (Naga)

ability.name: Flood Season
ability.description: Boost all water-domain allied cards by 3 power; enemy fire cards lose 3 power.

figures.description: The Khmer naga, a multi-headed water serpent who forms the balustrades of Angkor's causeways and bridges, symbols of the rainbow connecting earth to heaven.

figures.name: Harihara

ability.name: Divine Union
ability.description: Combine the abilities of any two allied god-type cards for a single super-ability.

figures.description: The composite deity uniting Vishnu and Shiva, widely worshipped in early Cambodia as the supreme god embodying all cosmic functions.

figures.name: Indra (Khmer)

ability.name: Thunderstorm Cavalry
ability.description: Summon three lightning riders with 6/6/8/5/5 stats who strike all enemies simultaneously.

figures.description: Indra as worshipped at Angkor, lord of the celestial armies and bringer of rain, depicted astride the divine elephant.

figures.name: Apsara

ability.name: Celestial Dance
ability.description: Mesmerize all enemy cards for 1 turn, preventing their attacks; allies gain 2 to all stats.

figures.description: The celestial dancer nymphs of Khmer heaven, carved in thousands across Angkor's walls, embodiments of divine beauty and cosmic art.

figures.name: Kala (Khmer)

ability.name: Devouring Arch
ability.description: Destroy one enemy card outright; its power is added to Kala's stats.

figures.description: The time-devouring demon face carved above temple doorways, said to consume all except the sun and moon, guardian and destroyer of entrances.

figures.name: Preak Thong

ability.name: Dragon Marriage
ability.description: Form a permanent alliance with one serpent-type card; combined stats become the total.

figures.description: The legendary founder-hero of Cambodia who married the naga princess Neang Neak, establishing the royal lineage of the Khmer.

figures.name: Neang Neak

ability.name: Naga Bride
ability.description: Grant the card bearing Naga Bride immunity to all serpent-type attacks for 3 turns.

figures.description: The naga princess who married the brahmin Preak Thong, her father draining the sea to create the land of Cambodia for them to rule.

figures.name: Yeay Mao

ability.name: Black Lady of the Sea
ability.description: Control the weather for 2 turns: choose calm seas (boost allies) or storm (damage all enemies).

figures.description: The Black Lady, powerful spirit of the sea revered by Cambodian fishermen, who controls the waters and protects or punishes sailors.

figures.name: Thmorda

ability.name: Clever Plea
ability.description: Win any argument or contest with an opponent card; if you lose in power, win in wisdom.

figures.description: The clever orphan hero of Khmer folk tales who outwits judges, kings, and even demons through his quick wit and sense of justice.

figures.name: Preah En (Khmer Indra)

ability.name: Monarch's Shield
ability.description: Place an unbreakable barrier around one allied card for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Khmer version of Indra, chief of the heavenly devas and protector of righteous kings, summoned in royal rituals.

figures.name: Moni Mekhala

ability.name: Crystal Ball Flash
ability.description: Blind all enemy cards for 2 turns with a flash of crystal light; blinded cards cannot attack.

figures.description: The lightning goddess who carries a crystal ball, engaged in eternal battle with the thunder demon Ream Eyso, their contest creating storms.

figures.name: Ream Eyso

ability.name: Thunder Axe
ability.description: Hurl the axe at Moni Mekhala or the highest-magic enemy; deal 9 damage.

figures.description: The thunder demon who endlessly pursues the lightning goddess Moni Mekhala, his axe throw creating thunder when it strikes the heavens.

figures.name: Garuda (Khmer)

ability.name: Eagle Strike
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one naga-type enemy; naga allies flee the field if present.

figures.description: The divine eagle who serves Vishnu and battles the nagas, carved prominently at Angkor as a symbol of solar power and royal might.

figures.name: Preah Ko

ability.name: Ancestor's Guard
ability.description: Protect all allied cards from death effects for 1 turn; restore 2 HP to all.

figures.description: The sacred bull, one of the founding ancestor figures of the Khmer kingdom, whose temple at Roluos is among the oldest at Angkor.

figures.name: Thompadey

ability.name: War Elephant Charge
ability.description: Deal 9 damage to all enemy cards simultaneously; recharge requires 3 turns.

figures.description: The great Khmer war elephant hero, whose sacred battle elephants were the tanks of the ancient battlefield in Angkor's military campaigns.

figures.name: Bayon Face

ability.name: All-Seeing Gaze
ability.description: Reveal all hidden cards; enemy strategies are exposed and allies gain foreknowledge (+2 all stats).

figures.description: The enigmatic smiling stone faces of the Bayon temple, believed to represent the Bodhisattva Lokesvara or King Jayavarman VII himself watching over the kingdom.

figures.name: Preah Bat Dambong Dek

ability.name: Iron Staff Sweep
ability.description: Sweep all enemies on the field; deal 6 damage to each.

figures.description: The hero who founded a kingdom with his iron staff, one of the legendary predecessors in the founding myths of the Khmer people.
